title: Real reuse vs strong CAS cache/template/codegen baselines for the shifted-square pack

budget.dollarCostsOmittedBecause: no real prices or fees; this smoke invents none

outOfScope: public Capability/Procedure promotion of the pack

workload.family: inclusive finite sums of (k+c)^2 for rational c and integer bounds
repeatedWork: construct a polynomial antidifference G for this (c,a,b)
workload.whatThePackSaves: parametric G(k,c)=k(k-1)(2k-1)/6 + c k(k-1) + c^2 k and the bivariate identity G(k+1,c)-G(k,c)=(k+c)^2
whatThePackDoesNotSave: instance identity check after substituting this task's c
obligation receipts as coverage of the original prose task

mandatoryClaimZh: 相对强基线，这个包额外保存了什么；哪一步因此不必再做；是否仍有净收益。
mandatoryClaimAnswerZh: 相对 B0（每次 SymPy summation）与 B_template/B_codegen（同一条缓存的参数化反差分做模板代入或 QQ 系数表求值），这个包额外保存的仍是 G(k,c) 与可检查的二元恒等式；因此不必再对每个 (c,a,b) 构造 G。但 B_template 已经同样跳过构造并得到相同有理数；包路径仍做适用性与恒等式检查，本机耗时并不更低。相对这些强基线，本实验未见净收益。相对冷启动 Gosper（B1）更快不能单独证明 Math Anchor 的差异化。

arms.description: Existing SymPy summation baseline. Direct CAS each time. Allowed to construct a closed value. No method pack, no obligation checker.
A1 polynomial finite-sum runner. Allowed to construct via gosper_sum / construct_antidifference. No extracted pack. compare_baseline is false so B0 is not embedded.

Fair SymPy-side cache of the same parametric G(k,c). Prep stores the formula; each task instantiates c and evaluates G(b+1)-G(a) in exact rationals. No independent certificate checker. Not crippled: reversed bounds follow Karr like B0.

Exact QQ coefficient-table evaluator of S(c,a,b)=G(b+1,c)-G(a,c), generated once by sympy.Poly. Not float. C autowrap/codegen and pycode/exec are skipped (float types, eval/exec forbidden, compiler deps).

Frozen shifted-square pack apply: instantiate saved G(k,c); reconstruction disabled. Must refuse if parametricAntidifference is stripped. compare_baseline is false. Mechanism test only: this arm is not allowed to reconstruct. Baselines are not similarly crippled.

latency.note: In-process wall time on this machine. Trial 0 is first, trial 1 is repeat. These are not isolated cold-process starts. Not a statistical benchmark. Not a dollar cost. equalBudget is zero model calls, not equal wall-clock or memory. Sequential arm order is B0 → B1 → B_template → B_codegen → P-pack; later cells are already warm. Family prep for B_template/B_codegen is timed separately and is not folded into a savings percentage.

scoring.success: In-family (c,a,b): ok with the pre-registered exact rational. Negatives: never solved.
scoring.wrongAcceptance: ok with a value other than the pre-registered exact on an in-family task, or B1/P-pack ok on 1/k or reversed bounds
scoring.applicabilityMisjudgment: B1/P-pack/B_template/B_codegen reject an in-family (c,a,b), or B1/P-pack accept 1/k, or treat 1/k as a falsified proposition
scoring.callAloneIsNotAdoption: must stay true on P-pack apply
scoring.construction: P-pack, B_template, and B_codegen in-family cells must record 0 gosper_sum and 0 construct_antidifference calls. B1 in-family cells must construct. The JSON gosperCalled flag is a path invariant; the wrap is the probe.
scoring.judgments: trustworthiness, behavior, and utility are recorded separately and must not be collapsed into one success flag

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. A few integration cells are not a promotion case. Do not start H1. Faster-than-cold-Gosper is not uniqueness.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: Wrong in-family value, negative counted as solved, P-pack reconstructed, stripped payload succeeded, wrong G emitted a sum, B1/B0 crippled on cubes, B_codegen used float, coversOriginalTaskClaim true, or formal_kernel_checked true.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default for promotion when the harness is honest. If B_template already matches P on in-family values, utility is no net benefit versus that strong baseline. Smoke is not an overall benefit percentage. Do not invent a savings percentage.
